params.title: Parameters
params.intro: Saved for this model and applied to every message. Empty fields use the model's own default.
params.unsupported: This model's backend exposes no adjustable parameters.
params.think: Reasoning. Have the model emit its thinking before the answer, for models that support it.
params.temperature: Randomness. Lower is more focused and repeatable.
params.top_p: Sample only from the most likely tokens whose probabilities add up to this.
params.top_k: Sample only from this many most likely tokens. 0 disables it.
params.min_p: Drop tokens less likely than this share of the most likely one.
params.max_tokens: Longest reply, in tokens. On Ollama, -1 means no limit.
params.stop: Sequences that end the reply, one per line.
params.repeat_penalty: Penalise repeating recent tokens. 1 disables it.
params.presence_penalty: Penalise tokens that have appeared at all.
params.frequency_penalty: Penalise tokens by how often they have appeared.
params.penalize_nl: Include newlines in the repetition penalty.
params.mirostat: Adaptive sampling that targets a steady perplexity. 0 is off.
params.mirostat_tau: Mirostat target: lower is more focused.
params.num_ctx: Context window to load the model with. Larger uses more memory.
params.num_gpu: Layers to place on the GPU. 0 runs on the CPU; -1 lets Ollama decide.
params.num_thread: CPU threads. Usually best left to the backend.
params.keep_alive: How long the model stays loaded after use, e.g. 10m, 1h, or -1 for always.
params.cache_prompt: Reuse the cached prefix of the conversation between turns.
